about_short_description.short_description: Sanvivo creates a multifaceted platform to enable customers to order medications and get pharmaceutical advice at local pharmacies.

product.name: Sanvivo Pharmacy Integration Platform
product.description: A platform that connects local pharmacies with online platforms, shops, delivery services, and e-prescription apps to consolidate orders and manage inventory.

product.name: Sanvivo WhatsApp Messaging Integration
product.description: A service that allows pharmacies to receive WhatsApp messages directly on their cash register computer without using a mobile phone, compliant with data protection regulations.

product.name: Sanvivo E-Prescription Portal
product.description: A portal that allows pharmacies to receive electronic prescriptions directly from customers via app submissions, bypassing intermediaries.
